# Byro

> Byro is an events platform for Nigeria and Africa. People find events near them, get tickets in seconds, and collect a stamp in their passport every time they show up. Organisers create events, sell tickets and check guests in.

Site: https://www.usebyro.com

## For people going out
- [Discover events](https://www.usebyro.com/discover): concerts, sports, nightlife, conferences and community events, searchable by city and category.
- [Communities](https://www.usebyro.com/communities): organisers and groups on Byro, with their upcoming events.
- [Refund policy](https://www.usebyro.com/refund-policy): when ticket buyers are refunded, and how long it takes.

## For organisers
- [Pricing](https://www.usebyro.com/pricing): what Byro charges and how payouts work.
- [FAQ](https://www.usebyro.com/faq): hosting events, selling tickets, check-in, payouts and cancelling.

## About and legal
- [Blog](https://www.usebyro.com/blog)
